sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: This day you will be prone to be stubborn and uncompromising in your business and professional dealings and thereby inviting unnecessary problems. Ganesha urges you to guard against this tendency and conduct yourself cordially and amiably with your colleagues and clients. The day will turn out well for executives and administrators. Do not fret too much about the work in hand. Things will turn out fine.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Water your plants today and make sure they're getting enough light, Taurus. If you don't have any plants, take this opportunity to go to the nursery and pick up a couple for your home or office. Nourish the organic things in your life to help remind you of your own roots, which are extremely important for you right now. Sink deep into the Earth in order to understand the environment around you.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Beauty can be found anywhere if you look for it. Connect with your surroundings throughout the day, darling Taurus, and notice how one setting differs from the next. Creative inspiration can also be gained when the Virgo Moon squares Uranus. However, this energy can make you vulnerable to impulsive spending you may later regret.

readings.text: On the financial front, Ganesha predicts that things will just be so-so today. However, you shall not face any sort of financial constraint, and shall be comfortable on this front.

You may need to reconsider recent financial plans. Your head is full of all kinds of amazingly creative ideas. If you're a writer, journalist, or publisher, this is a great time to be you. But you need to use these gifts in a responsible way. Make sure you're saving your money with a reliable company.

You feel the wind at your back with the planetary configuration of the day. You feel alive and well despite your tendency to overwork yourself at times! Go forward with your healthful habits this week. Priority should be on eating a balanced diet, so cut back on bread and remember you can never drink too much water. In fact, a light fast would greatly increase your energy. Try to eat lightly and rule out carbohydrates and milk products every other day for five days.
